name: business-triz
description: TRIZ for organizational, service and people-centric problems: Function Analysis in plain language for non-engineers, Perception Mapping of stakeholder beliefs, and solution ideas across super-system and sub-system levels.

interface.longDescription: TRIZ methods for organizational, service and people-centric problems. Break down what each role and activity does with a plain-language Function Analysis for non-engineers in fields such as education, healthcare, customer service, retail, HR and hospitality; surface stakeholder beliefs and the hidden contradictions between them with Perception Mapping; and generate solution ideas from the resources of the super-system and the sub-systems. For managers, facilitators and consultants. The Skills structure the thinking; they do not replace knowledge of the people and the organization involved.
defaultPrompt: Map the perceptions behind a recurring conflict in our team.
Explain in plain language what each role in our customer service process does.
Find solution ideas for our problem at super-system and sub-system level.
